description: Deploy this directory to its linked Rebase Cloud project (`rebase cloud deploy`). Builds, uploads and follows the deployment to a terminal state, then checks the new version answers. Production changes. A deploy can take minutes; `wait: false` returns once it is triggered.

app.description: Which app of rebase.json to deploy. Default: the one the CLI picks

bundle.description: Deploy as a managed bundle (`--bundle`). Needed when the CLI answers `managed_project`

message.description: A label for the deployment in its history

preview.description: Serve this build on an address of its own and leave production alone

previewName.description: Name the preview, so later deploys with the same name update it. Implies preview

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to follow it before giving up. Default: the CLI's 15 minutes

wait.description: Follow it to the end (default true). false returns as soon as it is triggered

name: rebase_cloud_deploy
